rationale: fluorinated additives are mapped to a LiF-rich SEI proxy
carbonate solvents/additives are mapped to a lithium-carbonate-rich SEI proxy
phosphate additives are mapped to a Li3PO4-like SEI proxy
borate additives are mapped to a lithium borate SEI proxy
sulfite or sulfone-like additives are mapped to a sulfite-rich SEI proxy
nitrile additives are mapped to an N-rich inorganic SEI proxy
